facts.body_text:
def _(world):
    latest = queued_fills(world)[-1]
    expect(latest).to(contain(f"{ORDER_FILE}:12-14: {EMPTY_CART_COMMENT.text}"))
    expect(latest).to(contain(f"{ORDER_FILE}:30-31: {LINE_30_COMMENT.text}"))
def queued_fills(world) -> list[str]:
"""The fills sent to checkout-chat, oldest first."""
newest_first = world.data_of(world.Chat.load(CHECKOUT_CHAT).messages())
return [message["text"] for message in reversed(newest_first) if message["kind"] == "fill"]

self._text = text

self._sent_at = sent_at
self._state = state
self._reason = reason
super().__init__(f"chat {chat!r} is not connected: is the cdd-board mod loaded in it?")

link = self.link_to_new(folder, prompt)

self._file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with self._file.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as kept:

self._folder = folder

self._state_file = JsonFile(folder / STATE_FILE)

folder = _chats_folder()
chats = [cls.load(entry.name) for entry in sorted(folder.iterdir())] if folder.is_dir() else []
return [chat for chat in chats if chat.is_connected]

if not self.is_connected:
    raise ChatNotConnectedError(self.id)
waiting = self._folder / WAITING
waiting.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path = waiting / self._next_file_name()
JsonFile(path).write({"kind": kind, "text": text, "sent_at": self.clock()})
return self._message(path, WAITING)

found = next(((path, state) for state in MESSAGE_STATES if (path := self._folder / state / f"{message}.json").is_file()), None)
return self._message(*found) if found is not None else None

sent = [(path, state) for state in MESSAGE_STATES for path in self._sent_in(state)]
newest = sorted(sent, key=lambda entry: entry[0].name, reverse=True)[: self.kept_messages]
return [self._message(path, state) for path, state in newest]

self._folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
self._write({"name": name, "is_busy": is_busy, "seen": self.clock(), "folder": folder, **self._title_state(self._state)})
self._finish_worked_on(is_busy)
return self._take_ready(is_busy)

taken = self._folder / TAKEN / f"{message}.json"
if not taken.is_file():
    return self
if not is_shown:
    record = JsonFile(taken)
    record.write({**record.read(), "reason": reason})
self._move(taken, SHOWN if is_shown else FAILED)
return self

shown = self._folder / SHOWN / f"{message}.json"
if shown.is_file():
    self._move(shown, DONE)
return self

for state in (TAKEN, FAILED):
    unshown = self._folder / state / f"{message}.json"
    if unshown.is_file():
        record = JsonFile(unshown)
        record.write({key: value for key, value in record.read().items() if key != "reason"})
        self._move(unshown, WAITING)
return self

taken: list[ChatCommand] = []
for path in self._sent_in(WAITING):
    command = JsonFile(path).read()
    if command["kind"] == "fill" and is_busy:
        continue
    self._move(path, TAKEN)
    taken.append(ChatCommand(path.stem, command["kind"], command["text"]))
self._forget_old_messages()
return taken

kept = Path(state["transcript"]) if state.get("transcript") else None
if kept is not None and kept.is_file():
    return kept
found = ChatPointer.from_claude_chat(self.id)
return found.transcript if found is not None else None

latest = max((int(path.stem) for state in MESSAGE_STATES for path in self._sent_in(state)), default=0)
return f"{max(int(self.clock() * NANOSECONDS_PER_SECOND), latest + 1)}.json"

folder = self._folder / state
return sorted(folder.glob("*.json")) if folder.is_dir() else []

folder = self._folder / state
folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
path.replace(folder / path.name)

sent = JsonFile(path).read()
return ChatMessage(path.stem, sent["kind"], sent["text"], sent.get("sent_at", 0.0), state, sent.get("reason", ""))

entries.filter((entry, index) => entries.findIndex(other => other.path === entry.path) === index)

this.store.change(state => ({ toasts: [...state.toasts, text] }))
setTimeout(() => this.store.change(state => ({ toasts: state.toasts.filter(shown => shown !== text) })), TOAST_MILLISECONDS)

this.current = { ...this.current, ...change(this.current) }
for (const listener of this.listeners) listener()

return [message["text"] for message in reversed(newest_first) if message["kind"] == "fill"]

return [(change["kind"], change["range"]["start_line"], change["range"]["end_line"], change["removed"]) for change in opened["changes"]]

self._name = guidance.key
self._session = session
# The folder the project's ``.context/config.json`` names for this practice, read once for each answer.
self._configured_folder = HeldForAnswer[str | None]()

self._save_chosen_outputs({key: value for key, value in self.chosen_outputs.items() if key != "root"})
return self

super().__init__(f"{fidelity.name} does not write {format}; it writes {', '.join(fidelity.outputs) or 'nothing'}")
self.fidelity = fidelity
self.format = format

named = Format(format).name
if named not in self.offered_formats:
    raise FormatNotOffered(self._fidelity, format)
others = [each for each in self.chosen_formats if each != named]
chosen = self.chosen_formats if is_chosen and named in self.chosen_formats else others + ([named] if is_chosen else [])
self._practice.save(formats={**self._practice.saved.get("formats", {}), self._fidelity.name: chosen})
return self

folder = self.reports_folder
return sorted(folder.glob(f"{self._fidelity.slug}-*.md")) if folder.is_dir() else []

folder = self.reports_folder
folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
return folder / f"{self._fidelity.slug}-{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(REPORT_DATE_FORMAT)}.md"

repo = self._session.repo
found: list[Path] = []
for label, paths in self.output_paths().items():
    for path in paths:
        declared = self._declared(path)
        named = [repo.root / declared.glob] if declared.names_one_path else self._found(label, declared)
        found += [file for file in named if file.is_file()]
return found
return any(self._exists(label, file) for label, file in self._declared_outputs() if file.names_one_path)
return [(label, self._declared(path)) for label, paths in self.output_paths().items() for path in paths]

root = self.root.resolve()
extensions = _CODE_EXTENSIONS.get(Format(label).name, (Format(label).extension,))
worked_on = sorted(file for file in changed() if file.suffix in extensions and (file == root or root in file.parents))
return [FileEntry(self._session.repo.path_from_top(file), file.exists(), True) for file in worked_on]
return [file for file in self._session.session_files.find(declared.glob) if self._fidelity.declares(file.as_posix(), label)]

names = [declared] if isinstance(declared, str) else list(declared)
is_single_file = len(names) == 1 and not set(names[0]) & _OUTPUT_PATTERN_MARKS
return [PurePosixPath(names[0]).with_name(chosen_name).as_posix()] if chosen_name and is_single_file else names

folder_mark = "/" if name.endswith("/") else ""
declared = PurePosixPath(name)
if CONTEXT_FOLDER in root.parts and declared.parts[:1] == (CONTEXT_FOLDER,):

return f"{(root / declared).as_posix()}{folder_mark}"

text = str(value)
return text if len(text) <= _SHOWN_CHARACTERS else f"{text[:_SHOWN_CHARACTERS]}…"

self.session = session

self.repo: Repo = sessions.repo
self.repo_path: Path = sessions.root

self.context_config = ContextConfig(self.repo_path)
self._workpath: Path | None = None
self._session_path: Path | None = None

self._resolved_paths: dict[str, Path] = {}

self._session_json: HeldJsonFile | None = None

self._outputs: dict[str, PracticeSessionOutput] | None = None
self._graph: Graph | None = None

self._graph_practices: frozenset[str] = frozenset()

self._parts_lock = threading.RLock()
self.decision_records = DecisionRecords(self.work_root / CONTEXT_FOLDER / _DECISION_RECORDS_FOLDER)
self.handoffs: Handoffs | None = None

self.session_files = SessionFiles(self)

    self._graph = None

self._session_path = folder

self._fields.drop()
self.handoffs = Handoffs(folder) if folder is not None else None
self.progress_cache = ProgressCache(folder)

named = str(path)
held = self._resolved_paths.get(named)
if held is None:

return held

path = Path(named)
return path.resolve() if path.is_absolute() else (self.repo_path / path).resolve()
self.save_fields(**{_PARENT_FIELD: parent.name if parent is not None else "", _PULLED_OUT_FIELD: False})
return self._sessions.create(title, self.work_root, title=title, scope=scope, parent=self.name)

idea = self.idea_file
idea.write(idea.heading or self.title or self.name, text)
self._saved("text")

unknown = [name for name in overlays if name not in patterns]
if unknown:

self.save_fields(overlays=list(overlays))
with self._parts_lock:
    if self._graph is not None:
        self._graph.overlays = list(overlays)

held = self._session_json
file = held if held is not None else JsonFile(self.session_file)
try:

finally:

    AnswerReads.begin()
self._saved(", ".join(f"{name} {_shown(value)}" for name, value in values.items()))

kept = self.session_path / file.name
file.replace(kept)
self._saved(f"keeps {file.name}")
return kept

parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
destination = parent / self.name
moved_from = self.session_path

self.session_path = destination
self._sessions.moved(self, moved_from)
self._saved(f"moves to {parent.name}")
return self

found = self.practices.get(name) or self._own_outputs.get(name)
if found is None:
    raise UnknownPracticeError(name)
return found

# A practice root a person chose is kept relative to the workpath, so each is saved again against the new one
# and still names the same folder.
# The practices on the new workpath are kept again with it, so each root is kept by the practice that works there.
chosen = {key: practice.folder for key, practice in self.practices.items() if practice.is_root_chosen}
self.workpath = self._sessions.in_checkout(self.repo_path, self.repo_path / path)
self.save()
moved = self.practices
for key, root in chosen.items():
    moved[key].keep_root(root)
return self

"""Step 1 - Read the handoff format once via read_handoff_format."""
tools(self.read_handoff_format)
"""Step 2 - Draft the handoff markdown from what the caller passed in that format, tailored to {{next_focus}} when provided."""
"""Step 3 - Write the handoff markdown to a file and call write_handoff with paths set to that file. Do not pass the handoff body."""
tools(self.write_handoff)
"""Step 4 - Commit and push the handoff on the current branch with repo.push_commit (message: "Handoff: {session}"). Report the handoff path and the pushed commit."""
return "Handoff written, committed and pushed."

"""Step 1 - Read the format once via read_cdr_format. Internalise the three-criteria gate and the minimal template."""
tools(self.read_cdr_format)
"""Step 2 - Optionally call list_cdrs so you do not re-record an already-captured decision. Records live under the session workpath's .context/cdr/."""
tools(self.list_cdrs)
"""Step 3 - During the session (grill, sketch, or generate), watch for decisions that meet ALL three: hard to reverse, surprising without context, and a real trade-off. If any criterion is missing, skip the CDR."""
"""Step 4 - When a qualifying decision crystallises, offer a CDR briefly (title + one-line gist). If the user accepts, write the record to a file and call write_cdr immediately with a kebab slug and paths set to that file. Do not pass the record body. Do not batch; do not wait until the end."""
"""Step 5 - Keep CDRs short. Prefer a single paragraph. Add Status / Considered Options / Consequences only when they add genuine value."""
return "CDR session active."
return this.shown && this.board?.columns.some(column => column.name === this.shown && column.kind === 'stage') ? this.shown : this.stage

const column = this.board?.columns.find(column => column.name === this.shownStage) as { actions_with_formats?: string[] } | undefined
return column?.actions_with_formats ?? ['generate', 'render']

const ticket = this.ticket
if (!ticket) return []
return ticket.progress
  .filter(progress => progress.stage.name === this.shownStage && progress.is_enabled)
  .map(progress => new FidelityProgressClient(progress, ticket, this.practiceNamed(progress.practice.key), this.selected.includes(progress.fidelity.slug), this.labelOf(progress.fidelity.slug)))
return this.selectedFidelity ?? this.fidelities.find(fidelity => fidelity.slug === this.ticket?.next?.fidelity.slug) ?? this.fidelities[0] ?? null

const selected = this.fidelities.filter(fidelity => fidelity.isSelected)
if (selected.length) return selected
const one = this.actionFidelity
return one ? [one] : []

state = self._state
return state.get("title") or state.get("name", "")

relative = self._chosen_or_configured_root or self._guidance.default_workspace_folder
return self._session.folder_under_root(relative)

if not self.enabled:
    return ""
canvas = CanvasVersions.in_practice_root(self.output_root)
return canvas.link(canvas.latest) or ""

chosen = self._chosen.get("root")
return self._session.folder_under_root(chosen) if chosen else self._practice.output_root
return self.session_path is not None and self.session_path.parent.name == COMPLETE_FOLDER

with self._parts_lock:
    working = frozenset(key for key, output in self._own_outputs.items() if output.enabled)
    if self._graph is None or working != self._graph_practices:
        # Only the practices the session works on: a practice turned off for it is never read into its graph.
        graph = Graph(self._own_outputs[key].guidance for key in self._own_outputs if key in working)
        self._graph_practices = working
        # A session uses a graph created for it and saved in its own folder; a graph saved anywhere else, such
        # as the graph tool's, is not the session's.
        graph.kept_in = self.session_path
        graph.open_saved(self.work_root)
        if self.overlays:
            graph.overlays = self.overlays
        self._graph = graph
    return self._graph

outputs = self._own_outputs
return {key: outputs[key] for key in self.graph.practices.held}

latest = self.handoffs.latest
return self.from_project(latest) if latest is not None else ""

from space.session.file_comments import FileComments

return FileComments(self)
